title: Transfer Matrices and Ehrhart Theory for Path and Cyclic Block Polytopes
summary: We study block polytopes whose variables are divided into equal-size blocks and whose local inequalities bound the total contribution of adjacent blocks. For blocks arranged along a path, we develop a transfer-matrix enumeration in the length direction. We also carry out an Ehrhart-theoretic analysis in the dilation direction. The original transfer matrix admits a compression to a weighted height matrix, and the numerator and denominator of the length generating function are described by explicit recurrences and determinant formulas.
